content: Od Uyu Irouya

Jesus Kristus nẽ kurõ fesiya od, are ereb kaisã bagai wõ youf anĩ, Negurem yogon ferfer ifelnẽdiyouf nigin Jesus ifenen. Jesus ĩ, yogon ferfer Jon od anĩ keleĩ youf nigin, yogon engel Jon bun sur fen.
Jonem ereb ereb ganan ĩ ilen anĩ kurõ falaisif, are Negur nẽ od ado, Jesus Kristus nẽ od.
Taka ĩ profet od enei iwesef are ĩ el fiyek, agef fen, idi anĩ karĩ de fen, ereb anĩ bun itoton anĩ waud bun dinof anidi el fedif, ere nigin, sain mogo dodolef.
Jon Sios Sewen Bun Yogon Aanya Sur Fen
Aya Jon, Asia provins bun sios sewen bun pas enei atotof. Negur ĩ gama ibodok, kulu ibodon, dumen isiyouf bunem, uur sewen yogon king nẽ sia wagen difaref bunem ado,

Jesus Kristus ĩ Negur nẽ od el fe dõf wogõ yedig, ĩ tamo gare den bun tamal uyulil kel turĩ fiyen, tenebur king ganan neid mudur ĩ bunem, wau ifenẽya ado wau inosiya ã bun isif. Jesus ĩ ada nigin wau laaf fen, yogon naud bunem, ada neda mosor bun tamal yalelnadan.
Agef fen, ĩ ada yogon Tama Negur aruna yaleya nigin, in tano ado in pris inodan. Ĩ bun fula fiya medeĩya ado megeir gai gai ibodkalauf! Momoi.

content.text: Age fe di, meleid ganan ĩ dilouf,
idi ĩ gilĩ difen anidig dilouf.
Age fe di, tamo kayau tenebur ein ganan ĩ nigin waud gudũ fouf.
Are agef bagai wõ youf! Momoi.

content: Odug Negur irok, “Aya uyulil ado idikeleya, aya gama abodok, kulu abodon, dumen asiyouf, aya saa ilun nẽ kusĩ tamo guri afeid uyu aroudig anĩ.”
Taka Ĩ Tamo Naal Gen
Aya Jon, ãgenei tureĩ, aya, Jesus bun darau, Negur nẽ tano ado, feseya sã ifareya, ã geid taledig, aya Negur nẽ od ado Jesus nẽ od wogõ aun nigin, Patmos nuyo bun abodon.
Odug nẽ naa bun, aya Awa Uur namen abod ken, aya dumeun ait odug taur gen wõ ye mog, karĩ aun.
Ait iron, “Ereb õ ulef anĩ, buk kori fiya bun utot fen, sios sewen bun sur wediyouf, oun Efesus, Smerna, Pergamum, Taiataira, Sardis, Filadelfia ado, Laodisia.”
Aya ait wogõ fiyan anĩ ileya nigin falei aun. Aya falei aul fen, lam nẽ gol tutur sewen ailedin.
Lam tutur anĩ atun, aib taka “tamo naal gen”
kolos meluk ifonũ di, yen isilen ado, let gol akor gu fen anĩ ifaren.
In mudur ado fatiya, sipsip siwi lalau, saa lalo lalau gen, yogon mala are yã mala fitotoleya gen.
Yogon ye are bras yã malan ifalegeya medeĩya gen, in ait are naan uhuhuya gen.
Yogon ima biyalẽ barisa sewen iroun, agef fen, in awa bun tamal, dimig bala waila si sitakã wõ yen. Yogon nawa are gaa ririya gen medeĩ yen.
Aya ĩ ail fen, aya ĩ ye gariyan kubũ au, laa gen ainen. Age afe di, ĩ ima biyalẽ aya teteun ino fen, iron, “Õ to kumĩ wo. Aya gariya, aya idikeleya.
Aya mata ibodõya nẽ, aya laa fiyan, anĩ ere, uleyaf, aya gai gai mata abodkalauf! Aya laa nẽ ado Hades nẽ ki aroudif.
“Anĩ nigin, ereb õ ulen, ereb gama ibodok, ereb dumen wõ youf anĩ utot.
Barisa sewen aya imau biyalẽ ulen ado, lam nẽ gol tutur sewen ulen anĩ nẽ waa nẽ gariya, are eig fiya: Barisa sewen are sios sewen neid engel, lam nẽ tutur sewen are sios sewen.
